translated: And that concludes the "Twinkling Stars in the Night Sky" edition.
Everyone watching the stream, how did you like it?
I see so many wonderful comments coming in.
Someone said, "Saki-chan's painful delivery before the chorus was so good."
Thank you so much.
When we record, Icchan usually goes first. She's just so...
She's such an amazing singer, her takes are already so polished. I think everyone uses her vocals as a base,
like a guide for how the rest of us should record our parts.
But this time, partly because of the song's atmosphere,
I prioritized putting Saki-chan's emotions into it above all else.
I'm so happy to hear that the sadness I felt really came through to you.
"I'm glad you talked about so many things," and "It was great to hear your stories."
Such kind comments.
I always say this, but I really love these AfterTalks.
Recording is usually a solo job, even though I know you're all watching over me.
But during AfterTalk, I get to share my feelings with everyone as a fan too.
I'm not just the voice actress; I'm a viewer cheering for Saki-chan,
cheering for Leoni, and saying things like, "That was so painful," or "She's grown so much."
I love having time to talk about all that. It went by so fast, I might have talked too much!
It was a bit of a sad story, but it's become a very important
event story for me. I'm so grateful for this time to look back on it with all of you.
Thank you so much for joining me.
I'm sure you're all wondering what's going to happen next,
but there's no doubt that the members of Leoni all care deeply for one another.
